L01_female.wav.speaker: female
L01_female.wav.text: Good evening! Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?

L02_male.wav.speaker: male
L02_male.wav.text: Could you recommend something good for dinner tonight?

L03_female.wav.speaker: female
L03_female.wav.text: Our grilled salmon is very popular, and it comes with fresh seasonal vegetables.

L04_male.wav.speaker: male
L04_male.wav.text: That sounds delicious, but I should let you know that I have a nut allergy.

L05_female.wav.speaker: female
L05_female.wav.text: Thank you for letting us know; we can make sure your dish is completely nut-free.

L06_male.wav.speaker: male
L06_male.wav.text: Great, then I will have the salmon dish with a glass of white wine.

L07_female.wav.speaker: female
L07_female.wav.text: Excellent choice. Would you like to see our dessert menu after your meal?

L08_male.wav.speaker: male
L08_male.wav.text: Actually, I might be full, so could we just get the check later?

L09_female.wav.speaker: female
L09_female.wav.text: Of course! I will put your order in and bring your wine right away.
